about: Feature map: what the app does, how a user reaches each feature, and how to prove it works. Run: python ../memory/tools/verify/verify.py . (from this folder). Add a feature here in the same commit that adds its control; verify.py --coverage fails on any control id no feature mentions.

features.name: Deals load on open, newest collection time shown
features.reach: Open the app. Header line reads 'Updated N ago'; Hot is the default view.

features.name: Five views switch from the tab row
features.reach: Tap Hot / Ending soon / New openings / Birthday / Saved under the header.

features.name: Ending soon: only deals with a stated end date
features.reach: Tap the Ending soon tab.

features.name: Birthday view: pick month and day, kept on this phone
features.reach: Tap the Birthday tab, then the Month (#bday-m) and Day (#bday-d) pickers.

features.name: Search narrows the list; Clear filters restores it
features.reach: Tap Filter (#filter-btn), type in the search box (#q). The Showing line names the filter; Clear filters (#clear) resets.

features.name: Clear filters brings every deal back
features.reach: With any filter on, tap Clear filters (#clear) on the Showing line.

features.name: 1-for-1 and Free quick filters (Easy to claim, #t-easy, has its own feature)
features.reach: Tap Filter, then the 1-for-1 (#t-1for1) and Free (#t-free) chips.

features.name: Category chip filters by food type
features.reach: Tap Filter, then a category chip in the first chip row.

features.name: Save a deal; it appears in the Saved view
features.reach: Tap Save on any card's footer row, then the Saved tab.

features.name: Share copies the link where the share sheet is missing
features.reach: Tap Share on a card. Phones open the share sheet; elsewhere the link is copied and a toast says so.
steps: Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'share', {value: undefined, configurable: true}); Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', {value: {writeText: () => Promise.resolve()}, configurable: true}); 1

features.name: Report a card (Ended / Not food / Wrong details), kept on this phone
features.reach: Tap the flag on a card's footer row, then a reason. The card's flag stays pressed.

features.name: Copy reports from the sources list, one tab-separated line each
features.reach: After reporting a card, tap the sources count; the last line offers Copy reports.
steps: window.__copied = ''; Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', {value: {writeText: t => { window.__copied = t; return Promise.resolve(); }}, configurable: true}); 1

features.name: Bell turns the morning digest on: permission, push subscription, POST /api/subscribe (push stack stubbed)
features.reach: Tap the bell in the header and allow notifications. On iPhone the app must be on the Home Screen first.

features.name: +N lists the other sites that covered a deal
features.reach: Tap the +N button beside the source link on a card.

features.name: Tap the grey text to read the full summary
features.reach: Tap a card's grey summary text.

features.name: Read the full post text inside the card (loaded from details.json on the first tap)
features.reach: Tap a card's text where it says 'Read the full post'. The post's full text replaces the two-line summary; tap again for Less.

features.name: Each promo says what it takes (Needs: membership, min spend...) or that the post states nothing
features.reach: Read the line under a promo's tags: 'Needs: ...' or 'No sign-up, code or min spend stated'. Openings and headline-only posts show none.
expect: [...document.querySelectorAll('#list .needs')].every(n => /^(Needs: .+|No sign-up, code or min spend stated)$/.test(n.textContent))

features.name: Easy to claim keeps only real discounts you just walk in for (free, 1-for-1 or % off; nothing asked beyond timing)
features.reach: Tap Filter, then the Easy to claim chip (#t-easy). The Showing line names it.

features.name: Search by meaning: the query is embedded on the phone and ranked against each deal's vector
features.reach: Tap Filter and type a plain-words query such as 'free food'. After a moment the list re-sorts, best match first, and the Showing line says so.

features.name: Show more loads the next 12
features.reach: Scroll to the bottom of a view and tap 'Show 12 more'.

features.name: Source health list: which sites answered
features.reach: Tap the 'N/M sources' button (#health-btn) on the status row.

features.name: Refresh reloads deals without an error
features.reach: Tap Refresh (#refresh) in the header.

features.name: New-since bubble filters to deals that arrived since the last visit
features.reach: Reopen the app after new deals were collected; tap the speech bubble (#newsince) under the name.

features.name: Guided tour: open, step, untick, skip
features.reach: Tap ? (#tourbtn). Next (#tour-next) / Back (#tour-back) step through; 'Do not show again' (#tour-off); Skip (#tour-skip) closes.
